summary: TOOL-4 Filter products by category and brand
description:
As a customer, I want to filter so I can narrow down the catalogue.

* Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
* Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
* Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
* Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

criteria.text: Selecting one category → only products from that category appear.
Selecting two categories → products from both appear.
Combining a category and a brand → only products matching both appear.
Unchecking all filters → the full list returns.

cases.title: Selecting a single category shows only that category's products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in at least two different categories (e.g. Category A and Category B), with at least two products in Category A.
steps: Note the products currently listed and their categories.
cases.expected: Only products belonging to Category A are displayed; no products from any other category appear in the list.

cases.title: Selecting two categories shows products from both categories
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in at least three categories (Category A, Category B, Category C), with at least one product in each.
steps: Select the category filter 'Category B' as well, so both are selected.
cases.expected: Products from Category A and products from Category B are both displayed; products from Category C are not displayed.

cases.title: Combining a category and a brand shows only products matching both
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains at least one product in Category A of Brand X, at least one product in Category A of another brand, and at least one product of Brand X in a different category.
cases.expected: Only products that are in Category A and of Brand X are displayed; Category A products of other brands and Brand X products from other categories are not displayed.

cases.title: Unchecking all category filters returns the full list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open and the full catalogue contains products in at least two categories. The tester has noted the full unfiltered list of products.
steps: Select the category filter 'Category A' and confirm the list is filtered.
Uncheck 'Category A' so that no filters are selected.
cases.expected: The full product list is displayed again, matching the unfiltered catalogue noted before filtering.

cases.title: Unchecking all filters after combining a category and a brand returns the full list
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains products in several categories and of several brands. The tester has noted the full unfiltered list of products.
steps: Uncheck the category filter 'Category A' so that no filters remain selected.
cases.expected: After the last filter is unchecked, the full product list is displayed again, matching the unfiltered catalogue noted at the start.

cases.title: Category and brand combination with no matching products
cases.preconditions: The product catalogue page is open with no filters selected. The catalogue contains a Category A and a Brand Y, but no product that is both in Category A and of Brand Y.
cases.expected: No products are displayed, since no product matches both the category and the brand. Any empty-result message or wording is not specified in the story.
